entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: vector set op %s operand has %s sample schema
entries.rationale: lowerVectorSetOp receives parser-typed vector operands and lowers each through lowerVectorSetOpOperand, whose histogram, mixed, dropping, and ordinary branches all publish a closed float, histogram, or mixed sample schema. An opaque or invalid kind therefore means an internal lowerer broke its output contract; no PromQL operand can select this diagnostic as a language rejection.

guard: default of switch kind over [case chplan.SampleKindFloat, chplan.SampleKindHistogram, chplan.SampleKindMixed; default]
